title: Patch-Based Deep Kernel Learning for Data Assimilation and Bias Correction with Extremely Sparse Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.41596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data Assimilation (DA) reconstructs the state of a spatio-temporal system by combining sensor observations with the output of a numerical model. Since model states are high-dimensional while observations cover only a small fraction of the domain, DA is a challenging large-scale estimation problem, central to weather forecasting and oceanography. Classical variational methods such as 3D-Var rely on a hand-crafted background error covariance that assumes unbiased errors, and therefore cannot capture state-dependent correlations or systematic model biases. Moreover, their cost grows with the size of the domain. Deep learning (DL) methods can perform DA and bias correction (BC) non-linearly, but typically offer limited interpretability and no calibrated uncertainty estimates. We propose a hybrid framework that couples a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a learnable-kernel Gaussian Process (GP) to jointly perform DA and BC from extremel

translated_title: 基于图像块的深度核学习方法：面向极稀疏观测的数据同化与偏差校正
translated_abstract: 数据同化（DA）通过将传感器观测与数值模型输出相结合来重建时空系统的状态。由于模型状态是高维的，而观测仅覆盖域的一小部分，数据同化是一个具有挑战性的大规模估计问题，也是天气预报和海洋学的核心。经典的变分方法（如3D-Var）依赖于手工设计的背景误差协方差，该协方差假设误差是无偏的，因此无法捕捉状态依赖的相关性或系统性模型偏差。此外，其计算成本随域的规模增长。深度学习（DL）方法可以非线性地执行数据同化和偏差校正（BC），但通常可解释性有限，且缺乏校准的不确定性估计。我们提出了一个混合框架，将卷积神经网络（CNN）与可学习核的高斯过程（GP）相结合，从极度稀疏的观测中联合执行数据同化和偏差校正……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将卷积神经网络与可学习核高斯过程相结合的混合框架，能够从极度稀疏的观测中联合执行数据同化与偏差校正，兼具非线性建模能力、可解释性和校准的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework coupling a CNN with a learnable-kernel Gaussian Process to jointly perform data assimilation and bias correction from extremely sparse observations, offering nonlinearity, interpretability, and calibrated uncertainty estimates.
